Rasterise the provincial fuel layer to the rasterToMatch

Source: R/fire_data.R
prep_fuel_types_rast.Rd

Rasterises the provincial fuel layer to the rasterToMatch, clips to the study area, and optionally masks recently-disturbed cells. Returns a CATEGORICAL raster (terra::freq() summarises FBP labels).

Usage

prep_fuel_types_rast(fuel_types, recent_disturb, study_area, rtm)

Arguments

fuel_types

sf of provincial fuel-type polygons with a factor FUEL_TYPE_CD column (from get_fuel_types()).

recent_disturb

SpatRaster of recent disturbance (used as an inverse mask), or NULL to skip masking.

study_area

sf or SpatVector study-area polygon.

rtm

A rasterToMatch SpatRaster.

Value

A categorical SpatRaster of FBP fuel types, clipped to the study area and optionally masked of recently-disturbed cells.
